claims.claim: Grid convergence at alpha 4 deg (L2-L3-L4): CL 0.4941 / 0.5104 / 0.5229 on 3,957,746 / 9,271,143 / 23,261,119 tetrahedra.
assumptions: the three meshes share every sizing rule (one scale factor; mesh rev 2)
monotone convergence in the asymptotic range (|e32/e21| > 1)

coarser_triplet.note: monotone but pre-asymptotic: the finer pair changed more than the coarser pair (|e32/e21| = 0.58 < 1), so the observed order is negative and Celik's |ln| form would give a GCI that is not valid

reproduced.how: computed here from the stored coefficients

CMy.note: oscillatory or zero change: no asymptotic estimate

claims.status_reason: GCI_fine on CL 6.83 % (p 1.18); CMy oscillatory or zero change: no asymptotic estimate
limitations: discretisation error only; model error (inviscid) is separate
observed order p 1.18 is below the scheme's formal order 2, so the grids are only just inside the asymptotic range
pitching moment is not grid-converged (CMy -0.0723 / -0.0728 / -0.0668, oscillatory); stability numbers come from AVL and the neutral-point check CFD-07
claims.next_step: Use CL with a +-6.8 % grid band. A GCI under 3 % needs a level finer than L4 (estimate: 23.3 M x the 2.5 level-to-level ratio = about 58 M tetrahedra, about 100 GB), which does not fit this PC's 64 GB RAM; a cluster run or a prism-layer mesh would be the route

claims.claim: SU2's reported forces equal an independent pressure integration over the same wall triangles.
equations: F = -sum_i p_i n_i A_i (n into the fluid, from the owning tetrahedron)
assumptions: node pressures averaged to triangle centroids (SU2 uses the same nodal dual-area idea, so small differences are expected)
claims.ran_evidence: post-processing reads restart_flow.csv written by SU2
limitations: checks bookkeeping (reference area, axes, moment centre), not the flow solution

claims.claim: Induced drag from the Trefftz plane CDi 0.0115 at alpha 4 deg.
equations: CDi = (2/(q S)) * integral of 1/2 rho (v^2 + w^2) dA over the half plane
assumptions: far-field kinetic-energy form; streamwise perturbation neglected

independent_check.method: CL^2/(pi e AR) with AVL's span efficiency

claims.status_reason: Trefftz 0.0115 on the plane 0.3 m behind the wing TE vs CL^2/(pi e AR) 0.0121 (-5 %); planes further aft read 0.0108, 0.0099 as the trailing vortices dissipate on the tetrahedra, so the value depends on where it is measured
limitations: numerical dissipation of the trailing vortices before the plane
plane truncated at 4 m x 4 m

claims.claim: The inviscid solver's surface CD (0.0345) is not a drag prediction: the part above the induced drag is numerical, and it falls with every mesh refinement.
assumptions: no skin friction, no physical separation in an Euler run

evidence.what: the viscous drag the sizing uses

independent_check.method: Trefftz induced drag (CFD-08) and CD on every level

claims.status_reason: surface CD at alpha 4: L1 0.0524 -> L2 0.0401 -> L3 0.0371 -> L4 0.0345 (falls with refinement); 0.0230 of the L4 value is above the Trefftz induced drag 0.0115 and is numerical (blunt clamp and motor bases, tetrahedra); profile drag stays with analysis/aero/drag_buildup.py
limitations: a viscous (RANS) full-aircraft run with prism layers would be needed for a CFD drag number
claims.next_step: Car-roof / flight power test (aero M1, mass M3) remains the drag evidence.

claims.claim: Wall Cp above the incompressible stagnation bound (Cp = 1) is a local numerical overshoot: it covers under 1 % of wall nodes in every case and its share falls 6-fold from L1 to L4 but not on every step, so it is a discretisation artefact, not a physical pressure.
claims.units: % of wall nodes with Cp > 1 (L4, alpha 4)
equations: share = nodes with Cp > 1 / wall nodes of the listed parts
assumptions: nodal values from the restart file
a physical feature would not shrink with refinement; a discretisation overshoot does
claims.ran_evidence: read from the SU2 restart files

independent_check.method: share of Cp > 1 nodes on L1 -> L2 -> L3 -> L4 at alpha 4 (must fall) and Bernoulli bound

claims.status_reason: share of wall nodes with Cp > 1 at alpha 4: L1 0.74 % -> L2 0.21 % -> L3 0.11 % -> L4 0.13 % (does not fall monotonically); the L3 -> L4 rise is the htail (219 -> 761 nodes, peak Cp 1.54 -> 1.47); largest share in any case 0.74 %; peak Cp 2.18 on the gear (L1_a4.0) at a sharp corner or small leading-edge radius
limitations: local surface pressures at leading edges and box corners from these runs are not usable; no design number in the repo takes CFD surface pressure (structural loads come from cad/Sim.cs load cases, sizing from analysis/sizing.mjs)
claims.next_step: Refine the htail leading edge (mesh audit STD-04: H-tail LE spacing is above 0.1 % local chord on every level) and re-check the share; no design number depends on it

claims.units: % section cl at 4 deg vs XFOIL inviscid, L2 spacing
equations: same SU2 INC_EULER numerics as run_cases.CFG on a 2-D gmsh mesh of the same NACA 2415 section
assumptions: 2-D section behaviour carries over to the 3-D wing's chordwise resolution
wall size, TE size and curvature rule copied from build_mesh.py at each level
